name: Baseline 5
definition: Specifies the commercial details of the underlying transaction.

SubmitterBaselineIdentification.name: Submitter Baseline Identification
SubmitterBaselineIdentification.definition: Identifies the baseline provided by the submitter.

ServiceCode.name: Service Code
ServiceCode.definition: Identifies the service requested by the submitter by means of a code.

PurchaseOrderReference.name: Purchase Order Reference
PurchaseOrderReference.definition: Reference to the purchase order of the underlying transaction.

Buyer.name: Buyer
Buyer.definition: Party that buys goods or services, or a financial instrument.

Seller.name: Seller
Seller.definition: Party that sells goods or services, or a financial instrument.

BuyerBank.name: Buyer Bank
BuyerBank.definition: Financial institution of the buyer, uniquely identified by its BIC.

SellerBank.name: Seller Bank
SellerBank.definition: Financial institution of the seller, uniquely identified by its BIC.

BuyerSideSubmittingBank.name: Buyer Side Submitting Bank
BuyerSideSubmittingBank.definition: Financial institution on the buyer's side, uniquely identified by its BIC. As part of the transaction, it may submit data sets.

SellerSideSubmittingBank.name: Seller Side Submitting Bank
SellerSideSubmittingBank.definition: Financial institution on the seller's side, uniquely identified by its BIC. As part of the transaction, it may submit data sets.

BillTo.name: Bill To
BillTo.definition: Party to be invoiced for the purchase.

ShipTo.name: Ship To
ShipTo.definition: Party to whom the goods must be delivered in the end.

Consignee.name: Consignee
Consignee.definition: Party to whom the goods must be delivered.

Goods.name: Goods
Goods.definition: Goods or services that are part of a commercial trade agreement.

PaymentTerms.name: Payment Terms
PaymentTerms.definition: Specifies the payment terms by means of a code and a limit in time.

SettlementTerms.name: Settlement Terms
SettlementTerms.definition: Specifies how the underlying transaction should be settled.

PaymentObligation.name: Payment Obligation
PaymentObligation.definition: Specifies the details of the payment obligation between financial institutions in this transaction.

LatestMatchDate.name: Latest Match Date
LatestMatchDate.definition: Specifies the latest date on which a data set must be matched with a baseline.

CommercialDataSetRequired.name: Commercial Data Set Required
CommercialDataSetRequired.definition: Specifies that a commercial data set is required for each shipment part of the transaction.

TransportDataSetRequired.name: Transport Data Set Required
TransportDataSetRequired.definition: Specifies that a transport data set is required for each shipment part of the transaction.

InsuranceDataSetRequired.name: Insurance Data Set Required
InsuranceDataSetRequired.definition: Specifies that an insurance data set is required for each shipment part of the transaction.

CertificateDataSetRequired.name: Certificate Data Set Required
CertificateDataSetRequired.definition: Specifies that a certificate data set is required for each shipment part of the transaction.

OtherCertificateDataSetRequired.name: Other Certificate Data Set Required
OtherCertificateDataSetRequired.definition: Specifies that another type of certificate data set is required for each shipment part of the transaction.

IntentToPayExpected.name: Intent To Pay Expected
IntentToPayExpected.definition: Specifies that IntentToPayNotice message(s) are expected as part of this transaction.

TransShipmentRule.definition: If TransportDataSetRequired is present, then Goods/TransShipment is mandatory. If TransportDataSetRequired is absent, then Goods/TransShipment is optional.
